descriptionBodyPlain:
Join us as an Account Executive – Accountant Channel to turn France’s accounting firms into one of Qonto’s strongest growth channels. You’ll build your own pipeline of firms and close them end to end, under the guidance of Adrien Cannet, our Lead Accountant Channel.
➡️ What you’ll do
Build your own pipeline: You’ll source and prospect accounting firms across France, with no inbound to lean on.
Own the whole sales process end to end: qualify, understand how each firm works and where its pain sits and close the deal.
Turn firms into referral partners: You’ll get accountants recommending Qonto to their own client base.
Use AI to work smarter: You’ll lean on AI tools to prep calls, personalise outreach and speed up qualification.
➡️ What we’re looking for
Outbound experience: At least one year
